semantics.how: Collapses runs, ranks blocks, orders branches true left and false right, places fixed-size nodes and routes edges
semantics.what: Lays out a function's blocks as a flowchart scene
semantics.when: Used by the viewer's flowchart view
semantics.why: A dedicated simple algorithm suits single-entry structured graphs

semantics.how: Absorbs a block into its predecessor when it has one sequential edge in and its predecessor one sequential edge out, rewiring edges
semantics.what: Merges runs of straight-line blocks into one node
semantics.why: Straight-line code should not render one box per statement group

semantics.how: Returns entry, loop, decision, exit or sequential based on incoming, loop-back and branch edges
semantics.what: Infers a block's shape type from its edges
semantics.why: Block units store only names, so shape comes from structure

semantics.how: Walks forward edges from the single entry, ignoring loop-back edges
semantics.what: Ranks blocks by longest path from the entry
semantics.why: Gives a top-to-bottom order without cycles
